get.description: At most 25 items per page. The default all board combines published ranked and enabled unranked records before sorting and pagination; each item retains its board and exposes displayScore. The rank field numbers only eligible ranked records in the selected sort order, before search or pagination; unranked records have rank=null. Public text reports only.

get.description: The saved judge reference from canonical spawn to original exit, without coin detours. Requires the same visibility as the run. Coordinates are world X/Z metres. Unavailable references return only available=false; approximate=true is not a globally exact optimum. No recomputation or score changes.

delete.description: confirm must equal the path id. Requires local administrator service and CSRF. Deletes proof, replay, matching private preview copies and linked competition/source records. Active uploads or judge jobs return 409. Filesystem failure returns 503 and keeps a hidden tombstone for retry. Public CDN copies expire within 60 seconds.
